findings.sizeof: PetscMalloc1(nEq, &psol) allocates using the current LSCtx element type; no explicit PetscBool byte count or fixed offsets.
findings.MPI communication: MPI calls communicate PetscInt/int arrays and scalar data, not PetscBool or enclosing contexts.
findings.binary layout: LHSCtx and LSCtx are local C++ structs compiled together with current headers; no fixed offsets or external ABI.
findings.reinterpret cast: No conversion of PetscBool storage to int pointers or raw packed bytes.
findings.serialization: No raw write/read of PetscBool, LHSCtx or LSCtx.
